implementation_choices.diffusion_width: 1792/28 heads is a documented width choice; FiCA reports 28 blocks and about 2B parameters but not width/head count.
implementation_choices.latent_pack: SDXL 512->64x64x4; invertible pixel_unshuffle(2)->32x32x16 reconciles supplementary dimensions. Packing is not specified in FiCA.
implementation_choices.clip: OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14 selected; exact CLIP checkpoint is not specified by FiCA.
implementation_choices.refiner_channels: Diffusers UNet2DConditionModel with the default channel widths, full-resolution convolution/skip connections and self/cross-attention only at resolutions <=64. Exact FiCA U-Net configuration is unpublished; this attention placement and the 1K-step single-identity default are our choices, not a released FiCA architecture/training recipe.
implementation_choices.refiner_laplacian: Row-L1 normalized geometry-dependent cotangent matrix, to bound skinny-triangle weights; FiCA does not publish the Laplacian definition/reduction.
implementation_choices.refiner_quality: Our fixed mesh-centroid constraint, foreground-normalized photo L1, texture MSE with weight 0.1 and initial-mesh displacement penalty (weight 0.25, world scale 0.01). These compensate for measured translation drift and suppressed texture updates in our single-identity experiment; they are not released FiCA loss reductions/weights. Best is selected by mean held-out total loss, without GT vertex error in the objective/selection.
implementation_choices.upm: FiCA identity bias pyramid + driving decoder, following URAvatar; layer widths are an implementation choice, not a released FiCA architecture.
implementation_choices.driving: NeRSemble FLAME expression->learned 256D adapter, eye axis-angle->gaze vectors; not the private Codec Avatar expression encoder.
implementation_choices.uv_repair: Our auxiliary foreground head (384->64->1), balanced BCE/Dice, FP32 UV decoder and source-grid triangulation. These details are not released FiCA code. XYZ/normal weights stay fixed.
implementation_choices.geometry_repair: Our XYZ/std/3 codec normalization, complete geometry-latent supervision (outside atlas is known padding), decoded endpoint XYZ/vertex/edge losses, and template-relative Laplacian MeshBridge (lambda=10). Not released FiCA implementation details; DiT/ControlMLP architecture and frozen SDXL VAE weights are unchanged.
implementation_choices.supervision: FLAME-derived canonical geometry and train-view UV observations are pseudo targets. Missing texture is excluded from supervised losses.
implementation_choices.smoke: Only smoke overrides width/depth/resolution. Pretrained Sapiens-1B, SDXL VAE and CLIP remain real external models.
